paragraphs.text: Waiter is an acorn class for restaurant workers and other related professions who serve food.

Waiter debuted as a creature type in Unglued on Mons's Goblin Waiters , a group of goblin waiters, and has yet to appear in any other set. In non-acorn sets, waiters would likely use the citizen class like with Speakeasy Server , which debuted in Streets of New Capenna .
